Plots for metabolism pathway scoring

Source: R/MetabolismPlot.R
MetabolismPlot.Rd

Plots for metabolism pathway scoring

Usage

MetabolismPlot(
  object = NULL,
  res = NULL,
  group.by = NULL,
  assay_name = "METABOLISM",
  ...,
  verbose = TRUE,
  srt = NULL
)

Arguments

object

A Seurat object containing the results of RunMetabolism.

res

GSVA results generated by RunGSVA function. If provided, 'srt' and 'group.by' are ignored.

group.by

Grouping variable used in RunMetabolism.

assay_name

Assay or tools slot containing metabolism results.

...

Additional arguments passed to GSVAPlot.

verbose

Whether to print messages.

srt

Deprecated alias for object; supply exactly one of the two. It will be removed in scop 1.0.0.

See also

RunMetabolism, EnrichmentPlot

Examples

Restored example output generated on 2026-10-13 from SCOP 53ed7e08f. These historical examples have not been revalidated against the current release. Current usage and arguments are documented above.

data(pancreas_sub)
pancreas_sub <- RunStandardWorkflow(pancreas_sub)

#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:36:46] Checking a list of <Seurat>...
#> ! [2026-10-13 16:36:46] Data 1/1 of the `srt_list` is "unknown"
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:36:46] Perform `NormalizeData()` with `normalization.method = 'LogNormalize'` on 1/1 of `srt_list`...

#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:36:47] Use the separate HVF from `srt_list`

#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:36:47] Finished check
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:36:47] Perform `ScaleData()`
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:36:47] Perform pca linear dimension reduction
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:36:47] Use stored estimated dimensions 1:23 for Standardpca
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:36:48] Perform `Seurat::FindClusters()` with `cluster_algorithm = 'louvain'` and `cluster_resolution = 0.6`
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:36:48] Reorder clusters...
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:36:48] Skip `log1p()` because `layer = data` is not "counts"
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:36:48] Perform umap nonlinear dimension reduction
#> ✔ [2026-10-13 16:36:56] Standard processing workflow completed
pancreas_sub <- RunMetabolism(
  pancreas_sub,
  db = c("KEGG", "REACTOME"),
  group.by = "CellType",
  species = "Mus_musculus",
  method = "AUCell",
  use_preparedb = FALSE
)
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:36:56] Start metabolism pathway scoring
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:36:57] Data type is raw counts
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:36:57] Averaging expression by "CellType" ...
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:36:57] Aggregated expression: 15998 genes x 5 groups
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:36:57] Using raw scMetabolism gene sets with species conversion to "Mus_musculus"
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:36:57] Converting 3297 human gene symbols to "Mus_musculus" via biomaRt ...
#> ! [2026-10-13 16:36:57] `GeneConvert()` failed: "variable names are limited to 10000 bytes". Falling back to direct symbol matching.
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:36:57] Total metabolism gene sets to score: 127
#> ✔ [2026-10-13 16:36:57] Metabolism scores stored in tools slot "Metabolism_CellType_AUCell"

ht1 <- MetabolismPlot(
  pancreas_sub,
  group.by = "CellType",
  plot_type = "heatmap",
  topTerm = 10,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  width = 1,
  height = 2
)
ht1$plot


ht2 <- MetabolismPlot(
  pancreas_sub,
  group.by = "CellType",
  plot_type = "heatmap",
  n_split = 3,
  topTerm = 100,
  use_raster = TRUE,
  width = 1,
  height = 2
)
ht2$plot


MetabolismPlot(
  pancreas_sub,

  db = "GO_BP",

  topTerm = 5

MetabolismPlot(
  pancreas_sub,
  group.by = "CellType",
  db = "GO_BP",
  group_use = "Ductal",

  topTerm = 5
)


MetabolismPlot(
  pancreas_sub,
  group.by = "CellType",
  group_use = "Ductal",

  plot_type = "network",
  topTerm = 3
)

  pancreas_sub,

)


MetabolismPlot(
  pancreas_sub,

pancreas_sub <- RunMetabolism(
  pancreas_sub,
  assay_name = "METABOLISM",

  species = "Mus_musculus",
  use_preparedb = FALSE
)
